_what: Assignment pack for the process specification campaign. Everything you need about YOUR category. The full model.json is 148 KB and you do not need it; if you want a process id outside this category, ask.
_binding: _Collab/00_prompts/SPEC_CAMPAIGN_PROMPT.md is the binding instruction. _Collab/SOURCE_AUTHORITY_PACK.md is the only permitted source list. Read both in full before writing anything.

bands.Work Lifecycle: 1.0-5.0. Runs in sequence for a single piece of work.
bands.Specialised Operations: 6.0-11.0. Each runs the full lifecycle inside its own operational discipline.
bands.Foundations and Enabling: 12.0-16.0. Supplies assets, materials, workforce, information and external delivery capacity to every lifecycle stage rather than sitting inside the sequence.
bands.Asset Lifecycle: 17.0-19.0. The asset's own life - planned, created, operated and retired - as distinct from the work performed on it. Appended 2026-08-29 without renumbering anything: categories 1.0 to 16.0 keep their ids, uids and legacy_ids.

lifecycle_axis._why: The model is organised on a WORK axis - identify, plan, schedule, execute, close. APQC and GFMAM are organised on an ASSET axis - plan and acquire, design and construct, operate, maintain, dispose. The work axis is what happens inside 'maintain'. Both are valid; carrying both lets the model answer ISO 55001:2024 cl. 8.1 without abandoning the granularity that makes it a process model rather than a benchmarking taxonomy.
lifecycle_axis._all: 'all' marks an enabling category that serves every stage rather than sitting at one of them.

your_category.name: Manage Vegetation

processes.name: Score and rank spans, circuits and segments
Obtain permission, permit and easement access
Manage refusal and agree alternate method
Dispose of debris and restore site
Perform post-work audit and quality inspection
Report to regulator and applicable reliability entity

your_category.summary: Control vegetation encroachment on the network as a recurring, largely contracted and separately regulated programme.

apqc_rows_touching_your_category.apqc_name: Manage capital program for productive assets
apqc_rows_touching_your_category.note: Manage capital programme. Closed 2026-08-29 by the Asset Lifecycle band: 17.4.1 investment plan, 17.4.3 financing, 17.4.5 programme monitoring. 2.4.1 still validates funding for the individual work item against what 17.4 produced.

Utility network planning. Closed 2026-08-29. 17.1 demand, capacity and modelling; 17.2.3 protection and 17.2.4 secondary systems, both electric-only; 17.2.5 pressure and regulation for gas. 3.1 continues to forecast WORK demand, which is a different thing with the same word.

Manage asset construction: 19226 quality control is 5.1, 19227 create work and asset records is 5.4, 19228 site safety and access is 4.4. 19225 Monitor work performance in flight has no group - the model measures after closure (15.1) but does not manage in-flight.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Asset Management Assurance and Audit
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: Audit exists per programme - vegetation, DIMP, reporting obligations - but there is no assurance process over the asset management system itself.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Demand Analysis
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: Demand the ASSET must serve - load, throughput, growth. Closed 2026-08-29 at 17.1. 3.1 continues to forecast WORK demand and crew capacity, which is a different thing with the same word; both now exist and are distinguishable.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Planning
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: Closed 2026-08-29. 17.2 determines the solution, 17.4 builds and monitors the capital programme. 12.5 continues to define maintenance strategy and 12.6.3 replacement and renewal.

gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.name: Life cycle Value Realization
gfmam_rows_touching_your_category.note: Closed 2026-08-29. 17.5 establishes the whole-life cost basis, compares intervention options over the life cycle and evaluates outcomes against the investment case. This is what ISO 55001:2024 cl. 8.1 requires and the model previously did not do.
